name: Recall

categories.label: VP gained during the game
categories.hint: Points already scored on the score track during play.

categories.label: Path of Knowledge (+ specialization)
categories.hint: Highest point symbol reached on each knowledge track, plus your specialization bonus if your marker is on this path.

categories.label: Path of Ancients (+ specialization)
categories.hint: 2 VP per white, gray and black ability stone (not your own colour), plus specialization bonus.

categories.label: Path of Legends (+ specialization)
categories.hint: 2 VP per vault built, plus specialization bonus.

categories.label: Path of Efficiency (+ specialization)
categories.hint: Points printed on all your keycards (incl. those in slots), plus specialization bonus.

categories.label: Path of Ambition (+ specialization)
categories.hint: Per relicube colour, points under your rightmost cube, plus specialization bonus.

categories.label: Path of Power (+ specialization)
categories.hint: Points at each monument location you built on, plus specialization bonus.

categories.label: Followers on board + white-crystal equivalents
categories.labelVi: Tín đồ trên bàn + tinh thể (quy ra trắng)
categories.hint: Convert red=2, purple=3 white crystals; add followers on the main board. 1 VP per 3.

categories.label: Starting objective card fulfilled
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành thẻ mục tiêu giữ kín
categories.hint: 15 VP if the kept objective card's requirement is met.

tiebreakers.description: Furthest on the white knowledge track
Then furthest on the gray knowledge track
Then furthest on the black knowledge track
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends when the round tracker reaches the last space (17 rounds); path cards are scored bottom to top and everyone scores all six, with the specialization bonus (A/B side) only for paths where your marker sits. Each path category here is entered as one total (base + specialization) read off the cards. Solo-mode differences not modelled.
